parent_objective: run corrected public L0/L1/L2/L3 profile comparison pilot with fixed seeds budgets and corrected controls
blocked_by: corrected configs and runtime semantics are ready but no corrected public pilot has run
supersedes: interpreting M1199 without current-tiled L2 controls and corrected L3 reset semantics
invalidates: profile comparison claims without corrected diagnostic controls

public_gates: M1209 may run the corrected public profile pilot only
M1209 may run PPO under the fixed M1206/M1207 profile budgets and seeds
M1209 must evaluate every checkpoint on the same public eval seeds
M1209 must not use private holdout
M1209 must not tune profiles based on results
M1209 must not run candidate replay
M1209 must not add hidden or oracle actor inputs
M1209 must not claim paper-level evidence or self-identification
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run public proof replay as if this were a driver candidate
do not tune hyperparameters after seeing profile results
do not add hidden or oracle actor inputs
do not claim recurrent-belief advantage or self-identification

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_corrected_public_pilot: fair L0/L1/L2/L3 trend with repaired controls
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: runs the first fixed-protocol public pilot with current-tiled L2 capacity controls and corrected L3 reset-control evaluation semantics
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: public pilot trend only; no promotion private-holdout paper-level generalization recurrent-belief or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if any profile cannot run the fixed protocol
stop if protocol changes after seeing a profile result
stop if corrected controls are bypassed during training or evaluation
fallback_plan: if full pilot is too costly, report a resource failure and route to smaller completed-subset audit
if one profile fails, record failure and route to focused repair before any comparison claim
if metrics are too weak or missing, route to evaluation-metric implementation before repeating
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1208 passed generated-config runtime smoke and M1209 is the corrected public pilot run

admission_evidence: M1196/M1197 pretrain smoke and M1208 no-training smoke provide capability evidence that profile train/eval paths instantiate before the corrected pilot
M1185/M1186 active public gate policy and M1208 exact generated-config smoke provide proof-gate discipline for keeping this public pilot separate from promotion
M1206/M1208 enforce rollback protection: no promotion, no private holdout, no per-profile tuning, and repair route if any corrected control fails
M1206 fixed the corrected profile set and budget
M1208 no-training smoke verified generated config runtime semantics
blocked_shortcuts: do not make paper-level or self-ID claims
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, review, and next manifest
next_stage_criteria: all selected profiles run with fixed budgets or failures are recorded
profile seed rows and aggregate rows are recorded
claim scope remains public pilot only
next audit, repeat, longer-budget, or repair milestone is selected

pilot_protocol.eval_seed_policy: same 64 public eval seeds for every profile checkpoint

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1209 can compare L2 profiles against current-tiled capacity controls, but the pilot does not by itself prove self-ID.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: Profiles differ in temporal information, but M1209 remains public pilot trend evidence rather than matched-history causal proof.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If current-tiled controls match or beat L2, record the negative result and route to profile/architecture audit instead of weakening claim standards.
allowed_claims: whether corrected controls warrant a longer public pilot
no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: The corrected fixed public pilot can produce useful L0/L1/L2/L3 trend evidence after controlling L2 current-frame substitution and L3 reset semantics.
success_criteria: all selected profile seed runs complete or failures are recorded
no promotion or actor-input contract change occurs
claims are limited to corrected public pilot trends
failure_criteria: profile-specific budgets or hyperparameters change after seeing results
metrics are framed as paper-level evidence
hidden or oracle actor inputs are introduced
failed profiles are omitted from summary
corrected controls are not applied in training or evaluation

commands.name: run_corrected_profile_pilot
commands.command: run fixed public corrected L0/L1/L2/L3 comparison pilot with equal seeds budgets and eval protocol

decision_rule: M1209 passes if the fixed corrected public pilot runs or records failures without claim expansion or protocol drift.
